summary: John's 2nd great-uncle; brother of William F. Meier.
bio: Born 24 Aug 1894 in Hazleton; saddler apprentice in a harness shop at 15 (1910); in Jan 1920, as 'Harry J. Jr.', 25, iron-works laborer, he lived at 296 Barney St next door to his parents with wife Mary and son Robert.
